_meta.name: backward_selection
_meta.description: Backward stepwise selection: REG_OLS with selection=backward starts with the full predictor set and drops the BIC-worst candidate each round, halting when removing any further predictor degrades the criterion. Sibling shape to 13_forward_selection.json (forward) and 11_stepwise.json (bidirectional) — backward is the canonical "start big, prune" subset-selection strategy. Forces the buffered orchestrator path.
